_: THE MEDIA FIXTURES. Ten permanent representative objects, one per family the slot contract has to survive. They are REGRESSION ASSETS, not mockups: every raster, the diagram and the video clip are generated by scripts/make-media-fixtures.mjs and committed, so a proof taken today can be retaken byte-for-byte later, and nothing is served by a third-party host.
presentationWidth: THE AUTHORED PRESENTATION WIDTH — what the author says this object should be shown at, in CSS px. It is NOT the raster's pixel width, and the raster's pixel width is never used as a presentation size: a 900x1200 photograph is not a request to be painted 900px wide. Under `contain` the painted width is min(presentationWidth, slotWidth); under `fill` it is the slot width and this field is not consulted.
aspect: height / width of the AUTHORED presentation, which is what the aspect class is read from. For a graph it comes from the authored domain instead, because a graph's shape is its mathematics.
